general.label: General
questions: Where are you based, and are you open to relocation?
Do you take on freelance or contract work?
answers: I am based in Mansoura, Egypt, and open to relocating to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for the right role.
Vue, Nuxt, and TypeScript on the frontend, and Node.js when a full-stack task requires it. I am also comfortable working with React and Angular.
Yes. I take shorter engagements and advisory work, and I am open to longer engagements as well. Reach out via the contact page.

work.label: Work
questions: What kinds of teams do you work best with?
How do you approach performance work?
Do you lead, or do you prefer to be an individual contributor?
answers: Small, senior frontend teams that ship SaaS. I have led teams of three to five and worked as the sole frontend lead on a founding team.

Measure first. Then a combination of lazy hydration, code splitting, image and font strategy, and reducing client-side work. In my most recent role I improved LCP by roughly 40% and reduced CLS by roughly 60%.
Both. I currently lead a frontend team, and I still ship code every day. I do not believe in leads who cannot deliver.

process.label: Process
questions: What is your view on tests?
answers: As a first-class requirement rather than a QA pass. That means WCAG 2.1 checks during code review, keyboard-flow validation, and semantic markup by default.
As a first-class concern from day one when the product requires it. I have shipped fully bilingual RTL and LTR applications in Arabic and English, including this website.
Types first, unit tests for tricky logic, and end-to-end tests for critical flows. I do not chase coverage numbers. I focus on confidence in the parts that are most likely to break.

about.title: Senior Frontend Developer and Team Lead.
about.subtitle: Six years of professional experience with Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, and real-time systems. Comfortable owning an end-to-end frontend and leading the team that delivers it.
intro: I am Ali. Over the past six years I have shipped production web applications, most of them SaaS products in the Saudi and Egyptian markets, and increasingly at a lead and senior level. Recently that has meant owning the frontend of multi-tenant platforms with significant real-time requirements, and building the registries and patterns that allow a small team to move quickly without the code turning into a tangle.

I care about the details that matter over the long run. Clear types. Honest error states. Pages that load quickly enough that no one has to apologize for them. Accessibility treated as a requirement, not an afterthought. Documentation that is honest about what a piece of code does not do.

I lead by example. I review pull requests carefully, mentor willingly, and hold a firm line on performance and accessibility standards. I have been Employee of the Month twice, which I mention only because it is a fair proxy for work that held up under real production load.

I am not tied to a single framework. I have shipped production applications in React and Angular. Earlier in my career I delivered enterprise Angular applications with Material UI, and I still reach for React on side projects and client work when it is the right fit.
currently_items: Leading the frontend at eDialogue Corner Society on the Ataa SaaS platform.
Open to relocating to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
